system.description:
Prerequisites: Advanced Dominate, Advanced Obfuscate. Named for the legendary anarch who used it to escape a Camarilla scourge by pinning blame on the scourge's own lieutenant, this Discipline combines Obfuscate's mental deception with Dominate's suggestive power to let the user apparently swap identities with anyone within 10 steps of her. The user makes a Mental Test against the person she intends to deceive (not the person whose appearance she's borrowing); it can be attempted against multiple witnesses via a group test, though only one identity swap occurs at a time. On success, the borrowed person takes on the user's appearance while the user assumes theirs down to the smallest detail for one hour. As a Dominate effect, it only functions against targets of equal or higher generation.

Costs 9 Experience Traits to learn.
